# QS-PROC-10 Machining surface finish (P2)
Revision: Rev E
Plant: P2, line P2-L3
Equipment: EQ-P2-L3-IH03

Scope
This quality specification defines the surface finish requirements and verification method for machined billets produced on line P2-L3 using EQ-P2-L3-IH03. It applies to machining operations that reference MM-P2-L3-IH03 and associated standard operating procedures SOP-P2-L3-02 and SOP-P2-L3-05.

Requirements table
| Characteristic | Requirement | Reference |
|---|---:|---|
| Coil cooling water flow for Machining induction billet heater #3 | The coil cooling water flow minimum for Machining induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P2-L3-IH03) is 72 L/min. | MM-P2-L3-IH03 |
| Surface finish acceptance | Surface finish must meet the acceptance criteria specified in MM-P2-L3-IH03 and be produced under the process controls of SOP-P2-L3-02 and SOP-P2-L3-05. | MM-P2-L3-IH03; SOP-P2-L3-02; SOP-P2-L3-05 |
| Process control | Operators must follow the setup and monitoring steps in SOP-P2-L3-02 and SOP-P2-L3-05 to maintain consistent surface finish. | SOP-P2-L3-02; SOP-P2-L3-05 |

Inspection method
Inspect surface finish using the measurement tools and methods specified in MM-P2-L3-IH03. Verify that setup and operational parameters align with SOP-P2-L3-02 and SOP-P2-L3-05 before measurement. Record inspection results on the batch record and flag any deviations referenced against MM-P2-L3-IH03.

Nonconformance handling
If inspection indicates nonconforming surface finish or if coil cooling water flow for EQ-P2-L3-IH03 is below the required value, stop affected production per SOP-P2-L3-05. Notify maintenance and quality, document the condition on the nonconformance report, and follow corrective actions defined in MM-P2-L3-IH03. Release of affected material requires documented rework and verification per MM-P2-L3-IH03 and SOP-P2-L3-02.
